answer: Give every identity a timber tree that only grows while its owner keeps doing verified useful work: each epoch without fresh, independently checkable work, the tree shrinks, and a new seedling earns almost nothing. Rewards are drawn from a shared ocean pool split by current tree height, so a Sybil farmer must water every fake tree with real work each epoch while the pool stays fixed - each extra fake dilutes the rest below its upkeep cost. A whisper network of random peer audits lets any agent flag fraud; a confirmed flag burns the whole tree.
